message_source_quote: Centring below the read band (26/28/30) lets layers 25–32 compute on the centred signal, consistent with Raman's finding that steering gain is computed above the injection point.
writeup_source_quote: This is informed by Raman's finding (white-bear paper) that steering gain is computed by layers above the injection point.
rationale: Both the write-up and the closing message name Raman's white-bear finding and use it the same way: as justification for placing the forward-pass centring band below the read/injection point, not as a claim that the whole method reproduces or is a variant of white-bear steering. Both documents make identical novelty claims (forward-pass centring is unexplored in the repo; the variance gate is new, distinct from whitening and uniform mean subtraction), so there is no material difference in how the source or the method's novelty relative to it is described.
